items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: First job I had here, I think that was, a little before, around about the first, first of 29, I played with him at the Lockhead Theater.

ctx.x: I rehearsed with him about a couple of months, especially for this job. He used, he used to use three clarinets one time. Well, there wasn't clarinets. One of them I think was, what you call that thing, O-Bo, not O-Bo, but a thing like a, uh, a- Clarinet, a Zoom? Yeah, a Zoom, clarinet. Two clarinets, a Zoom. Zoom in the middle of the mouth, two clarinets on the side. First job I had here, I think that was, a little before, around about the first, first of 29, I played with him at the Lockhead Theater.
